verdict.rationale: A live probe found a downloadable OpenAPI document at grafana.com/api/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), which meets the core of the story. However, no docs describe what the spec covers, and it is served from grafana.com, so it is unclear whether it covers the Grafana instance HTTP API or only the grafana.com platform API. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the spec and its scope, confirmation that it covers the Grafana instance HTTP API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
